correctness.rationale: The coordinate octahedron has eight faces of Euclidean area sqrt(3)/2. Every central normal section is the hexagon conv{(e_i-e_j)/2:i != j} with Euclidean area 3 sqrt(3)/4. Each of its six edge displacement vectors is itself a vertex, so its Minkowski self-perimeter is exactly 6 and recursive self-area exactly 3. Applying Definition 4.1 gives Omega_3=(1/3)*8*(sqrt(3)/2)*3/(3 sqrt(3)/4)=16/3. A boundary-factorization proof of product multiplicativity yields the all-odd-dimensional formula, while exact-rational CHECK.py independently confirms the finite geometry.

value.rationale: The new exact computation refutes the odd-dimensional branch of a specific 2026 extremal conjecture, not simply a routine benchmark: the value is 8/9 of the proposed minimum in dimension 3 and, through multiplicativity, in every higher odd dimension.
